blocks.h2: Reasons to Get a Sewer Camera Inspection in Geneva

tiles.body: A house from the 1800s almost certainly has an old lateral. Know its condition before you close.
Find out whether it's roots, a sag or a break.
Check the line and under-floor drains first.
Was it your line or an overloaded sewer?

blocks.h2: What We Find in Geneva Sewer Lines
blocks.intro: Geneva's footage varies a lot by neighborhood.

items.body: The most common finding in the historic district.
Lines repaired over a century show different materials joined together.
Low spots where newer lines settled.
Sometimes the pipe is fine and just needs cleaning.
In older homes, knowing exactly where a problem is matters. A located, measured problem means less disruption to floors and walls you want to keep.
If you're considering a liner, the camera tells us whether the old pipe is round enough to line and where any collapsed sections are.

blocks.h2: Sewer Camera Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Should I inspect the sewer before buying in Geneva?
items.answer: Yes. A standard home inspection doesn't include the sewer line. For an older home, a camera look can reveal a repair worth negotiating.

items.q: My older home has no cleanout. Can you still inspect it?
items.preview: Usually, through a toilet or vent, or we can add a cleanout.
items.answer: Usually. We can go in through a toilet flange or roof vent. Adding a cleanout makes future work much easier.

items.q: Can you tell where and how deep a problem is?
items.answer: Yes. The camera head carries a transmitter, and our locator marks the spot and depth from above.

items.q: How long does an inspection take?
items.preview: About an hour for most homes.
items.answer: About an hour for most homes, including the walkthrough of the video.

items.q: How much does a sewer camera inspection cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on access and length. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access and the length of the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
